Messages.Author: prestonp
Messages.Body: What happens to the card on it?

Messages.Author: david.tatu
Messages.Body:
It is always helpful to post the card text when asking a question:

Master: location. Put a card from your hand facedown (out of play) on this card when you play it. You may look at the card at any time. During your master phase, you may exchange a card in your hand for the card on this Storage Annex. If the Storage Annex is stolen or burned, the card on it is stolen or burned as well.

So what is your question? "Changing control" as in stolen? Or something else?

David Tatu
V:EKN Scribe

Messages.Author: prestonp
Messages.Body: Yea, as in stolen. I'm used to the card text you posted, but the card text in JOL does not include the last sentence.

Messages.Author: jhattara
Messages.Body:
Cards attached to another card come along when that card changes control. The last sentence has been removed because it is redundant.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
So, the only valid cardtext (the one you'll find under "Cardlist", here) is:
>
> Name: Storage Annex
> [SW:C/PB, LoB:PG]
> Cardtype: Master
> Master: location.
> Put a card from your hand face down (out of play) on this card when you play it. You may look at the card at any time. During your master phase, you may exchange a card in your hand for the card on this Storage Annex.
> Artist: Brian LeBlanc
>
If the location is stolen, cards on it are move alongside. Just like when you play Spirit Marionnette on a fully-equipped Una.

Messages.Author: prestonp
Messages.Body: Well there's just no case I can think of where an opponent's card can end up in ny hand or ash heap. So it's clearly unusual.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body: Cards "owned" by other players are returned to their ash heap / library, if they would be move to an ash heap / library.
